question: Does P4AF remain free of synthetic salt-like, banding and seam failures, and can one no-fit direct LOD preserve area-averaged density structure better than an unscaled-variance shortcut?

controls.constant_variance: same sensitometry mean, fixed P4AF peak variance, same copula correlation and seeds
controls.lod_unscaled: block-mean exposure with unchanged peak density variance and correlation sigma divided by factor

candidate_lod.peak_density_variance: P4AF peak variance divided by pixel area
candidate_lod.correlation_sigma_pixels: P4AF sigma divided by pixel factor
candidate_lod.comparison_truth: block-mean full-resolution developed density and transmittance

branch_rule.severe_fail: Close P4AF structure before photographs or LOD rescue; retain P4AD/P4AE analytic evidence only.
branch_rule.severe_pass_lod_fail: Retain P4AF as a full-resolution generic synthetic reference only; close direct LOD without retuning and freeze a distinct moment-aware LOD leaf only if justified.
branch_rule.all_pass: Retain the fixed direct LOD as a development candidate and open separately frozen scale/performance evidence; no photographs or product integration.

forbidden: amplitude, correlation, seed, LOD or gate retuning after results
stock, process, scanner, calibration or product claims
claim_ceiling: Synthetic severe-artifact and distributional LOD evidence for a generic derivative-conditioned developed-density approximation; not measured emulsion, photographic quality, stock response, calibration or product evidence.
